title: Anton and currency you all know

content.name: Anton and currency you all know
content.description:
2016 年，Berland 的你们都知道的货币对卢布的汇率上涨得非常厉害。为了简化计算，其小数部分被省略了，现在的汇率被认为是一个整数。

可靠消息人士告诉金融家 Anton，关于明天你们都知道的货币对卢布的汇率有一些信息。Anton 现在知道，明天的汇率将是一个偶数，并且它是通过交换今天汇率中的恰好两个不同的数字得到的。在满足这些条件的所有可能值中，明天的汇率将是最大的。可以保证今天的汇率 $n$ 是一个奇正整数。请你帮助 Anton 确定你们都知道的货币对卢布的明天汇率！
content.formatI: 第一行包含一个奇正整数 $n$，表示你们都知道的货币今天的汇率。数 $n$ 的表示长度在 $2$ 到 $10^{5}$ 之间（包含 $2$ 和 $10^{5}$）。$n$ 的表示没有前导零。
content.formatO:
如果关于明天汇率的信息有矛盾，即不存在满足条件的整数，输出 $-1$。

否则，输出你们都知道的货币对卢布的明天汇率。该汇率应当是在满足“偶数且通过交换恰好两位数字得到”的所有数中最大的一个。汇率的表示不应有前导零。

en.name: Anton and currency you all know
en.description:
Berland, 2016. The exchange rate of currency you all know against the burle has increased so much that to simplify the calculations, its fractional part was neglected and the exchange rate is now assumed to be an integer.

Reliable sources have informed the financier Anton of some information about the exchange rate of currency you all know against the burle for tomorrow. Now Anton knows that tomorrow the exchange rate will be an even number, which can be obtained from the present rate by swapping exactly two distinct digits in it. Of all the possible values that meet these conditions, the exchange rate for tomorrow will be the maximum possible. It is guaranteed that today the exchange rate is an odd positive integer $ n $ . Help Anton to determine the exchange rate of currency you all know for tomorrow!
en.formatI: The first line contains an odd positive integer $ n $ — the exchange rate of currency you all know for today. The length of number $ n $ 's representation is within range from $ 2 $ to $ 10^{5} $ , inclusive. The representation of $ n $ doesn't contain any leading zeroes.
en.formatO:
If the information about tomorrow's exchange rate is inconsistent, that is, there is no integer that meets the condition, print $ -1 $ .

Otherwise, print the exchange rate of currency you all know against the burle for tomorrow. This should be the maximum possible number of those that are even and that are obtained from today's exchange rate by swapping exactly two digits. Exchange rate representation should not contain leading zeroes.
